name: zcode-feishu-bridge
description: Mirror live ZCode sessions into Feishu streaming cards: tails ZCode rollout logs and renders per-turn progress (tools, reasoning, context usage, elapsed) as a CardKit typewriter card in a dedicated chat. Zero source patching, zero dependencies.

description_i18n.en: Mirror live ZCode sessions into Feishu streaming cards: tails ZCode rollout logs and renders per-turn progress (tools, reasoning, context usage, elapsed) as a CardKit typewriter card in a dedicated chat. Zero source patching, zero dependencies.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 ZCode 会话实时镜像到飞书流式卡片：tail rollout 日志，逐轮更新综合面板（模型/推理/工具/上下文/耗时）到专属会话的打字机卡片。不改 ZCode 源码、零依赖。

app_id.title: Feishu App ID / 飞书 App ID
app_id.description: Feishu app credential (cli_xxx). Empty = use environment variable FEISHU_APP_ID. 飞书应用凭据，留空则读环境变量 FEISHU_APP_ID。

app_secret.title: Feishu App Secret / 飞书 App Secret
app_secret.description: Feishu app secret; stored locally in ZCode config, never committed. 飞书应用密钥，仅存本地配置，不会入库。

base_url.title: Feishu base URL / 飞书域名
base_url.description: https://open.feishu.cn (default) or https://open.larksuite.com for Lark. 默认飞书国内域名，Lark 国际版填 https://open.larksuite.com。

notify_chat_id.title: Notify chat id / 接收卡片会话
notify_chat_id.description: Target chat (oc_xxx) for live cards; the app bot must be in it — a dedicated group is recommended. 接收实时卡片的会话，机器人须已加入；建议用专属群。

rollout_dir.title: Rollout directory / rollout 目录
rollout_dir.description: ZCode rollout log directory. Default: ~/.zcode/cli/rollout. ZCode 日志目录，默认 ~/.zcode/cli/rollout。

context_total.title: Context window / 上下文窗口
context_total.description: Model context window for the usage panel, e.g. 1000000 for 1M. 面板百分比用的上下文窗口大小，默认 1000000。

panel_fields.title: Panel fields / 面板字段
panel_fields.description: Stats-panel fields and order: project, model, reasoning, tools, context, tokens, elapsed. 综合面板字段与顺序，逗号分隔，默认全部。

auto_start.title: Auto start / 自动启动
auto_start.description: Start the bridge daemon automatically on session start (needs Feishu credentials). 会话启动时自动拉起桥接（需已配置凭据）。

debug.title: Debug logging / 调试日志
debug.description: Log every parsed rollout line to bridge.log. 在 bridge.log 记录每行解析日志，排障用。
